label: San Juan County, WA
note: San Juan County Assessor parcels (OpenData/Parcels/MapServer/1), the same download /shoreline bakes from: run node scripts/shoreline/fetch-county.mjs first (data/shoreline/raw is gitignored). Until 2026-11 this read Salish Sea Explorer's Feb 2026 Tax_Parcels.geojson (same fields). Owner is last-name-only and ~37% populated; no street address. Has Acres, plain-English land-use (Descriptio) and assessed value (Appraised_).
